title: Establish the private Vault chart delivery path
classification_reason: prepares a security-critical secret-management deployment path
introduces registry and Kubernetes access boundaries
expected_outcome: A reviewed Terraform design and validation path create a dedicated private ECR destination and a one-purpose VPC CodeBuild executor that can deploy the previously approved sealed Vault Helm release after chart/image mirroring and non-secret prerequisite checks.
constraints: Use only account 106760547719 and EKS cluster node-operator.
Do not initialize or unseal Vault, configure Vault, read or create any secret, or expose a public listener.
The executor may inspect only the existence and metadata of vault-tls, never its data.
All chart, runtime-image, and toolchain inputs must be digest/version pinned and available from private ECR at execution time.

Cluster-admin is prohibited by default. The only exception is a separately gated, Vault-dedicated EKS access-policy association used solely for the first Helm installation; its post-install removal is a required verification step.
Evidence contains no secret, kubeconfig, token, certificate, or raw CloudWatch log material.

external_actions: read non-sensitive AWS, ECR, and EKS metadata in account 106760547719
create or update the reviewed private ECR and VPC CodeBuild infrastructure only after Terraform plan review
mirror only approved digest-pinned public OCI artifacts into the dedicated private ECR destination
run the one-purpose private executor only to render Helm and verify non-secret prerequisite existence

after explicit user approval, temporarily associate AmazonEKSClusterAdminPolicy only with the dedicated Vault bootstrap role while it installs the approved sealed Helm release, then remove that association immediately
prohibited_actions: Vault Helm apply before the delivery-path plan is reviewed

primary_owner.responsibility: security boundary, Terraform integration, final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: a required datum is secret material

model_fallbacks.reason: the delegated Terra worker returned no implementation before interruption; Sol completed the bounded worktree change and will obtain a fresh independent Terra review.
